description: Retrieves statistical summary data and domain-level findings from the 2026 50-Site SaaS & E-Commerce AI Truncation Study, returning a Markdown report with JSON metrics on 25,000-token RAG cutoff rates (74%), visible price omission (62%), /llms.txt adoption (87%), and ARD 1.0 adoption (19%). Use this tool when comparing a website against industry peers (such as Stripe, Vercel, Datadog, or Shopify) or citing empirical benchmark statistics; do not use it to run a live scan on an arbitrary URL (use audit_ai_readiness instead). When domain is omitted or empty, returns the full 50-site aggregate dataset; when a bare domain is provided, normalizes case/protocol and checks whether that domain appears in the top-truncating cohort. Read-only static dataset lookup; requires no API key, makes zero external network calls, and never fails on unknown domains.

domain.description: Optional bare domain name (e.g., "stripe.com" or "vercel.com") to check against the 50-site benchmark cohort. Omit or pass empty string for the full aggregate summary.

name: query_truncation_benchmark
title: Query 2026 50-Site SaaS AI Truncation & /llms.txt Benchmark
